class.name: WorldLocationArea
class.brief_description: A named, discoverable location a body can enter and exit.
class.description: Marks a region of a scene as a location — a settlement, dungeon, or landmark, Creation-Engine "Location" style — and fires signals as a body crosses its bounds. Independent of [SceneManager]/[SceneDoor]: it lives inside a scene and never loads anything, it only announces itself for a HUD banner, map reveal, or fast-travel list to react to. When the scene's root is a [GameWorld], every [WorldLocationArea] under it is reachable without holding a reference of your own: [method GameWorld.get_locations] / [method GameWorld.get_location_by_id], or the [SceneManager] passthroughs [code]SceneManager.get_locations()[/code] / [code]SceneManager.get_location_by_id(id)[/code] / [code]SceneManager.get_world_game()[/code]. Nest a smaller [WorldLocationArea] inside a bigger one freely (e.g. a house inside a settlement) — each fires its own [signal location_entered]/[signal location_exited] independently; there is no built-in "innermost wins" resolution here.

method.name: is_body_inside
method.description: True while at least one body matching [member body_filter] is inside.

members.member: Group an entering/exiting body must belong to. Empty means any body.
If set, the first matching body to enter sets [member discovered] to [code]true[/code] (and fires [signal location_discovered]).
Whether this location has been found yet — pre-set it [code]true[/code] on a location the player should already know about (e.g. the starting settlement).
Human-readable name for a HUD banner or map label.
Stable identifier, looked up via [method GameWorld.get_location_by_id] / [code]SceneManager.get_location_by_id(id)[/code].
Broad category, informational for a map icon / filter.
Optional icon a map/HUD script can read for this location's marker.
If false, [signal location_entered] / [signal location_exited] never fire (discovery via [member discover_on_enter] still can).

signal.name: location_entered
signal.description: Emitted when the first matching body enters (a second matching body inside at the same time does not retrigger it).

signal.name: location_exited
signal.description: Emitted when the last matching body leaves.

signal.name: location_discovered
signal.description: Emitted once, the first time [member discovered] flips to [code]true[/code].
